name: 薩菲爾男性偏武 · 單手武器
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: athletic adult brown-skinned desert man with black curls and short neat beard, ivory headwrap, cobalt short coat over brass scale vest, crimson sash, loose sand-coloured trousers and dark riding boots. Held weapon: a single curved one-handed saber in right hand, left hand free. ROW1 six idle breathing poses; ROW2 six distinct attack keys: ready, strong anticipation, windup, contact, follow-through, recover. Draw weapon back with coiled waist, step and make a forceful diagonal cut with compact bright crescent slash then follow through. ROW3 six HIT recoil and recovery. ROW4 six blade parry GUARD poses. ROW5 six evasive low step and recovery DODGE poses. ROW6 six DEFEAT falling poses, last lies motionless on floor. Strongly differentiated action silhouettes. Keep entire weapon, hair and all particles INSIDE its cell. FLAT OPAQUE MAGENTA BACKGROUND. RGB.
